STAGE: design decision for ideation_5 (single candidate, no run).
GOAL: pick one mechanism that is in scope and attacks the measured failure (validation L1 negative-hit collisions) without rebuilding prefixes.
READ: the round brief only (no read permission on the workspace; read tool returned permission.rejected, so no repo files were inspected).
OBSERVED: the brief's own admissibility clause ("a move may only be taken when it does NOT increase the number of cross-cell neighbour pairs whose behaviour is disjoint", with a bound derived from the baseline's measured negative-hit rate) plus "prefer a partition that is untouched or nearly so" excludes any quantizer-side re-assignment, so the previous CURVCTRL-SID / BRad-RQ / poincare-frechet-codebook family (curvature applied to codebook updates or radial assignment) is out of bounds.
REASONING: the only coupling position left that is not a re-quantisation is a post-hoc, cardinality-preserving exchange of a small number of level-1 assignments, where Poincare geometry only SELECTS the exchange partner and the behaviour graph only GRANTS or DENIES it. Removing either changes the compute (geometry-off = Euclidean selector on the same points; behaviour-off = content-points selector with no gate).
OPEN: nothing was executed; the answer block is the deliverable and is appended as the next record.

STAGE: design decision, ideation_5 (one candidate, no run).
GOAL: choose one in-scope mechanism that attacks the measured failure (validation L1 negative-hit collisions) without rebuilding prefixes.
READ: round brief only; read tool and glob were permission-rejected, so no repo file was inspected.
OBSERVED: the brief's admissibility clause (a move admitted only if it does not increase cross-cell behaviour-disjoint pairs, with a bound from the baseline's measured negative-hit rate) plus "prefer an untouched or nearly untouched partition" excludes quantiser-side reassignment, hence CURVCTRL-SID, BRad-RQ and the Poincare-Frechet codebook family are out of bounds.
REASONING: the one coupling position left is a post-Stage-2, cardinality-preserving exchange of a few level-1 assignments where Poincare geometry only SELECTS the exchange partner and the behaviour graph only GRANTS or VETOES it; removing either changes the compute (geometry-off = Euclidean selector on the same points, behaviour-off = content-point selector with no gate).
OPEN: nothing executed; the answer block follows as the next record.

STAGE: final answer, ideation_5, candidate TAUSWAP-POINCARE-EXCHANGE (full text printed in the reply; this is the abstracted record).
Coupling position: post-Stage-2, cardinality-preserving 1-for-1 exchange of level-1 SID assignments inside frozen codebooks; no encoder, decoder, codebook, residual or loss change; no new prefixes; cell-size multiset and prefix vocabulary exactly preserved.
Behaviour signal: training-split directed adjacent item transitions C (each training user's last edge deleted to form an internal holdout), popularity-adjusted log-ratio r(i,j)=log((C_ij+1)/(T p_i q_j +1)).
Curved operator: unit Poincare ball, fixed kappa=1; behaviour points u_i = tanh(c||z_i||) z_i/||z_i|| from 32-dim truncated SVD of the non-negative PMI rows, c = 1/median||z||; per-cell Karcher (Frechet) mean m_b; d_P via Mobius addition and arctanh.
Coupling equation: accept(i,k) = 1[G>0] * 1[DeltaD<=0] * 1[DeltaR<=-DeltaD], G = w(i,b)(dP(u_i,m_a)^2-dP(u_i,m_b)^2) + w(k,a)(dP(u_k,m_b)^2-dP(u_k,m_a)^2), w(i,b)=max(0,rho(i,b)-tau), rho = mean r over the destination cell members.
Admissibility: DeltaD = change in disjoint same-cell pairs (r<tau), DeltaR = change in split behaviour-neighbour pairs (r>=tau, different cells), counted exactly over the affected pairs only; tau is the h0-quantile of r over same-prefix pairs, h0 = the baseline's measured TRAINING-internal negative-hit rate (prefix collision with zero retained transition). No validation or test data enters tau, the ordering or the cap.
Cap: accepted swaps <= |S_neg| (items implicated in the baseline internal negative hits) and each item moves at most once.
Diagnostic: validation L1 negative hit rate h1 vs baseline h0_val; if h1 does not fall the round is recorded negative with h0, h1, count, DeltaD, DeltaR and test_recall@10.
Cost: zero added cost in all 72000 Stage-2 steps (24/epoch x 3000) and no Stage-3 protocol change; one-time repair under 5 minutes on one card (truncated SVD about 5e5 nnz dominant, 1.2e7 FLOPs of Karcher means, 5e7 FLOPs of gains, 1e7 integer gate ops, about 3 MB).
Switches (implemented, not trained in this round): behaviour-off = w:=1, tau:=-inf, predicate forced true, u_i from encoder output; geometry-off = Euclidean distance and arithmetic means on the same points; both-on = the single run.
Success criterion: h1 < h0_val with under 1 percent of items moved and Stage-3 test_recall@10 > 0.065.
